name: Winter
overview: Scripture reveals that winter is a divinely ordained season marked by cold and inclemency, as God sets the borders of the earth and establishes the cycles of summer and winter (Psalms 74:17). The annual return of winter is assured and unceasing, symbolizing God's faithfulness to His covenant with creation (Genesis 8:22). Winter brings practical challenges such as cold that hinders plowing (Proverbs 20:4) and suspended navigation, yet it also illustrates spiritual seasons of adversity and reliance on God's provision. The imagery of snow and frost (Psalms 147:16) further underscores God's sovereign control over the natural order.
